about.label: About Me
about.heading: Who I Am
about.subtitle: Full Stack Engineer · Frontend Team Lead
about.bio1: I'm a Full Stack Engineer with a frontend-first mindset, strong backend experience, and a growing specialization in AI-assisted software development.
about.bio2: I design, build, and scale production-grade web and mobile applications using React, Next.js, FastAPI, and Node.js — while leveraging LLMs to accelerate development, improve code quality, and deliver intelligent features. I treat AI as an engineering multiplier, not a shortcut.
about.bio3: Beyond technical execution, I bring leadership, mentorship, and strong ownership. I currently serve as Frontend Team Lead at Media Revolution SRL, where I drive architecture decisions and mentor junior developers.
about.education_school: Instituto Tecnológico de Las Américas (ITLA) · Dominican Republic
about.education_details: Full Stack Web Dev · API Architecture · Agile · Cloud Deployment
about.cert2: Build Dynamic User Interfaces (UI) for Websites
about.exp0_role: Full Stack Developer / Frontend Team Lead
about.exp0_desc: Lead architecture for multiple client-facing apps. Integrate LLM-based workflows and AI-powered features into production. Mentor junior developers and establish team best practices.
about.exp1_desc: Built cross-platform applications using Vue.js, Python, and QT in Dockerized environments. Designed RESTful APIs and optimized MySQL queries for performance.
about.exp2_desc: Maintained internal platforms on Bit microfrontend architecture. Implemented automated testing with Cypress and Vitest. Built backend features using NestJS and Supabase.

projects.label: Portfolio
projects.heading: Selected Work
projects.subheading: A showcase of production projects spanning full stack web, mobile, AI integrations, and microfrontend architecture.
projects.proj0_desc: Production web platform with integrated LLM workflows and intelligent automation.
projects.proj0_long: Full stack platform built at Media Revolution SRL featuring LLM-based automation, prompt engineering pipelines, real-time data processing, and AI-driven user experiences. Includes a React/Next.js frontend with a FastAPI backend and PostgreSQL database.
projects.proj1_desc: Multi-platform application for a European client with Dockerized backend.
projects.proj1_long: Cross-platform application developed at Innovativity / GTS for an Italian client. Built with Vue.js for the frontend and Python for backend services, running in Docker containers. Features RESTful APIs, optimized MySQL queries, and responsive UI across web and desktop.

projects.proj2_long: Internal platform maintained at ATDEV built on Bit microfrontend architecture. Features a Vue.js frontend, NestJS backend, Supabase database, and comprehensive automated testing using Cypress and Vitest. Integrated third-party services including Zapier, Semrush, and Ahrefs.
projects.proj3_desc: Mobile application with cross-platform support and native device integrations.
projects.proj3_long: Cross-platform mobile application developed with React Native. Features offline-first architecture, native device integration, smooth navigation flows, and a shared codebase for iOS and Android. Backend powered by Express.js with JWT-based authentication.
